log_level.description: Logging verbosity: debug, info, warning, error, or critical

max_workers.description: Maximum number of concurrent speech synthesis workers

timeout_ms.description: Maximum time (in milliseconds) allowed for a synthesis request

max_buffer_size.description: Maximum buffer size (in bytes) for audio output

backend.host.description: Hostname or IP address of the backend speech server

backend.port.description: Port number for the backend server API

speech.engine.description: Speech synthesis engine to use (e.g., coqui, marytts, festival)

speech.default_language.description: Default language code (e.g., en, es, fr) for voice synthesis

speech.voices.description: List of available voices, each with configuration parameters

gender.description: Voice gender: male, female, or neutral

stability.description: Voice stability (0.0–1.0); higher = more consistent, less variation

similarity_boost.description: Similarity to original speaker (0.0–1.0); higher = closer match, less creativity

audio.output_format.description: Output audio format: wav, mp3, or opus

audio.enable_denoising.description: Enable or disable post-processing noise reduction

logging.file.description: Path to the main log file

logging.max_size_mb.description: Maximum log file size in MB before rotation

logging.max_backup_count.description: Number of rotated log files to retain
